name: RADIHALT Faraday Blankets and Mats: Product Specifications Dataset
description: A versioned, machine-readable reference for the four current RADIHALT Faraday blanket and mat variants for electromagnetic-field (EMF) shielding, including traceability identifiers, declared construction, care instructions, origin, and verification-status metadata.
provenance: RADIHALT first-party product and UPC/GTIN reference records reviewed 2026-09-22.

Construction, origin, and care fields are based on RADIHALT supplier documentation, including the signed 2026-06-08 supplier declaration and the supplier's 2026-07-26 composition and care clarification.
Third-party compliance files, supplier correspondence, Amazon media, customer reviews, and publisher-owned research tables are not redistributed in this release.
limitations: Material composition is supplier-declared and has not been independently verified by chemical, fibre-content, conductivity, or nickel-release testing.

Nominal sizes, original seller SKUs, identifiers, and marketplace links describe the reviewed product records; availability, offer-specific SKUs, packaging, and manufacturing details can change after this version date.
The UPC/GTIN artwork passed digital decoding checks, but physical printed-label verification was still pending at the version date.
This dataset does not report attenuation, signal-isolation, medical, health-outcome, or comparative-performance results.

shared_specification.construction: One cotton outer layer; one copper/nickel Faraday fabric inner layer; textile edge binding and stitching.
shared_specification.care_summary: Hand wash below 40°C with mild/neutral detergent; do not machine wash or tumble dry; hang dry cotton side out; cool iron outer cotton side only.
